editorial_review.method: Independently inspected original 2026-11-06 run artifact MP4 and meta, current-run review JPG, all 8 original-source preview JPGs and 20 independently decoded timeline frames from 0.5-40.8s; full FFmpeg decoded integrity and motion test.
editorial_review.scenes: Real European red squirrels visible in hook on tree, city ledge, park branches/tree trunks, log/stump, climb, and close-up eating nut payoff. Each scene is from a separate genuine filming source; narration explicitly distinguishes separate animals and places.
editorial_review.limitations: Some woodland frames are briefly obscured by branches/tree bark before the real squirrel reappears. These are actual source footage rather than unrelated filler; no claimed predator/continuous individual or synthetic zoom.
editorial_review.motion: FFmpeg froze-detect <= -55dB 1s and blackdetect >=0.8s found no events. No unnatural repeats or loops in 20 visual samples.
editorial_review.shot_max: All six measured Kokoro speech blocks 6.375-7.375s each and exactly eight unique original clips; no shot >8s.
editorial_review.safe_area: Word captions in lower-middle safe zone and top title, not bottom TikTok controls.
editorial_review.audio: Non-silent AAC audio, measured mean -27.8dB, peak -3.9dB.
editorial_review.credits: Live Commons commercial-use audit passed with original author + pages + CC BY 2.0/3.0/4.0 and modifications; no CC BY-SA/NC. Corrected post caption contains eight complete attributions.
